name: The product uses Vercel

find.note: A dependency line in package.json: the name as a key, then a version, so a script of the same name stays quiet. @vercel/ncc, @vercel/nft and @vercel/style-guide are build tools that run anywhere, so they don't say the team runs on Vercel.
vercel.json is Vercel's own config, so its opening line is the receipt.

why: Vercel is in the code or in what the repo declares, so its own MCP server lets the team's coding agent read that service. It's a team tool and never a pull request.
